title: Tunisian Fish Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired stew made with tender fish, aromatic spices, and a tangy briny sauce.

ingredients.name: Fresh Fish (4 fillets)
ingredients.notes: White fish (cod, tilapia, or mahi-mahi works well)

ingredients.name: Tunisian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of warm spices (cumin, coriander, cinnamon)

ingredients.name: Briny Sauce (lemon juice, garlic, and olives)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Tunisian Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the briny sauce, dried apricots, and chopped parsley. Stir to combine.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
